# Touch

`cinnabar:extension/touch@0.1.0`

Mod-owned on-screen buttons drawn in the built-in touch control style while touch controls
are shown. Players move them in the touch layout editor. Requires controls authority.

**Grants:** `controls`.

<a id="type-button"></a>

### `button`

A retained mod-owned touch control with player-adjustable default placement.

```wit
record button {
    id: string,
    label: string,
    anchor: anchor,
    offset: point,
    size: point,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | 1–32 bytes of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`. A player's saved<br>placement is keyed by it, so prefix it with the mod's name; when two mods use one<br>id, only the earlier mod's button is shown. |
| `label` | `string` | One line of 1–24 bytes of plain text without `§` codes, drawn centred as written. |
| `anchor` | `anchor` | Default placement, in GUI pixels inward from the anchored edges or right/down from<br>centred axes, each at most 1024. |
| `offset` | `point` |  |
| `size` | `point` | Width and height in GUI pixels, each 18 through 96. |

Types: [`anchor`](touch.md#type-anchor), [`point`](touch.md#type-point).

## Functions

<a id="set-buttons"></a>

### `set-buttons`

```wit
set-buttons: func(buttons: list<button>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Replaces this instance's retained buttons, at most 4; an empty list removes them.
Committed after a successful callback; quarantine, unload and revocation remove them.

Types: [`button`](touch.md#type-button).

<a id="read-presses"></a>

### `read-presses`

```wit
read-presses: func() -> result<list<string>, string>;
```

IDs of this instance's buttons tapped since its previous frame callback, oldest first.
A tap completes when the finger lifts inside the button. Empty outside `frame`; a
deferred frame keeps the taps for the next one.
